_guide: // projects.json - one card per project in the Projects section.
// schemaVersion: always 1. It tells the loader which shape to expect; do not change it.
// section: heading text plus on/off switches for search, filters, sorting and detail views.
// REQUIRED per project: id, title. Everything else is optional and is hidden when empty.
// id: unique and stable, prefix project- (project-001). Career Timeline and search reference it.
// title: card heading. Keep it short; it wraps.
// shortDescription: one sentence shown on the card.
// description: longer text shown in the details dialog.
// categoryId: must match an id in categories[] below.
// coverImage: path such as ./assets/images/projects/project-001/cover.webp. Empty = no image slot.
// imageAlt: describe the image for screen readers; required when coverImage is set.
// gallery: [{ id, src, alt }] extra screenshots for the details dialog.
// technologies: plain names shown as tags, e.g. ['React', 'SQL Server'].
// role: your part, e.g. 'Developer'.
// contributions: list of what you built, shown in the dialog.
// links: { liveDemo, sourceCode, documentation }. Any URL left empty is not rendered.
// status: 'completed' or 'in-progress'.
// dates: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. endDate null = not finished.
// featured: true puts a badge on the card.
// order: manual sort position (lowest first).
// enabled: false hides the record without deleting it.
// isSample: true marks example content; the section then shows a notice.

section.title: Projects
section.subtitle: Six projects from the project page, with sample details so every field is visible. Replace the sample text with the real story.

projects.title: Student Management System
projects.shortDescription: Sanjivani Library is a self-study center where students pay monthly fees to occupy assigned seats. This app manages the full student lifecycle:
projects.description:
This app manages the full student lifecycle:

Student self-registration with ID card photo upload
Admin approval queue (account approval + ID card review — independently)
Seat assignment during approval
Daily attendance check-in / check-out
Monthly payment tracking and receipt generation
Push notifications and email notifications
Public website with dynamic content managed by admin
contributions: Designed the relational schema for students, courses and marks.
Built the record forms with server-side validation.
Added result lookup by roll number and a printable report.

projects.title: Water Billing System
projects.shortDescription: Billing and payment tracking for a water supply office.
projects.description: A billing application that issues water bills from meter readings, records payments and lists outstanding balances per connection.
contributions: Modelled connections, tariff slabs and monthly readings.
Generated bills and tracked partial payments.
Added an outstanding-balance report by area.

projects.title: Auto Street Light Control
projects.shortDescription: Street lights that switch on at dusk and off at dawn.
projects.description: An Arduino prototype that uses a light sensor to switch street lights automatically, with a manual override and a delay to avoid flicker.
contributions: Wired the light sensor and relay module.
Wrote the threshold logic with hysteresis.
Tested the override switch and power failure behaviour.

projects.title: Smart Car Parking System
projects.shortDescription: Slot detection and an availability display for a small car park.
projects.description: A prototype that detects free parking slots with sensors and shows the count at the entrance, so drivers do not enter a full lot.
contributions: Placed IR sensors per slot and debounced the readings.
Documented the wiring for a rebuild.

projects.title: Room Light Automation (IoT)
projects.description: An IoT prototype that switches room lights from a phone over the local network, with a schedule and a physical switch fallback.
contributions: Connected the relay board to an ESP8266.
Built a small web control page served by the board.
Kept a physical switch working when the network is down.

projects.title: Walk API
projects.shortDescription: A small REST API for walking distance and daily goals.
projects.description: A REST API that stores walks, sums daily distance and returns progress against a goal. Used to practise API design, validation and pagination.
contributions: Designed the endpoints and request validation.
